title: Two Del Rio crashes: Willingham and the MJ-12 El Indio-Guerrero case
place_text: Del Rio, Texas / El Indio-Guerrero, Mexico

tellings.quote: >> which that's a huge can of worms because there's two crashes there. 1955 Robert Willingham in Del Rio, Texas and the 1954 Del 1950 Del Rio crash which is actually Elindio/g Guerrero, Texas, Mexico, which is only really talked about in the Eisenhower briefing document of the Majestic 12 documents.

plain: Two separate UFO crashes are said to have happened around Del Rio, Texas: one in 1955 tied to a man named Robert Willingham, and an earlier one, around 1950, at El Indio-Guerrero on the Mexican side. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says this, without naming a source, and stumbles a little over the dates. He adds that the second crash is really only talked about in the Eisenhower briefing document, one of the Majestic 12 papers, which describe a secret panel said to have handled recovered craft and include a briefing said to be for President Eisenhower. If true, one small area would hold two crash stories, not one.
